items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: We developed a friendship and the man gave me some secrets that I could never divulge

ctx.x: and then when I came into New York with Basie's band I met him in 1936 - it was the summer of 1936 and I was playing with Victor-Pillars. I left St. Louis and went back to rejoin Basie's band and when I got there, there was no band and no job. I had no thought of coming to New York, but fortunately somehow - it was the second week of July, 1936. We were fortunate enough to come into New York and open the Roseland Ballroom on the 24th day of December, which was Christmas Eve. The sign says: "Christmas Party, Count…
Bardu Ali, he was a singer, what -
